scene: Tucked into the humming sidecar, you rattle past turning cogs.
beats: Static crackles into bouncy accordion swing, setting the driver's boots tapping. You screech to a cheerful halt at Midnight Radio Repair as the sidecar door unlatches.
The copper badger purrs like a cozy engine and dispenses a brass mint. Wheels brake outside glowing windows, and Midnight Radio Repair's garage door rattles open.
The driver chuckles, pointing past spinning towers as the engine idles. You glide directly into Midnight Radio Repair's cluttered entry while its twin workshop doors swing wide.
picture: Flat side-scrolling cross-section of the sidecar motorbike speeding rightward. Far left sits the sidecar dash with its brass dial. Centre, the player in burnt-orange corduroy and beanie rests beside luggage holding a sleeping copper badger. Right, the driver grips chrome handlebars. Far right, bridge cables blur past.
shown: a tiny brass dial on the sidecar dash, far left
a copper wind-up badger curled on luggage, centre
the leather-helmeted driver gripping handlebars, far right

after.label: Step off at Midnight Radio Repair
Stay on
after.beat: You wave the shop goodbye as the bike zooms on, splashing through warm puddles. At the terminus you hop into a creaking window-cleaner gondola, ascending toward the whirring tanks of Rainmaker Rooftops.
